content: Conversation content on 13 June, 2023: [Jon]: Thanks, Gina! It's been so inspiring to work with our young dancers, seeing their passion and commitment. My advice? Don't be scared to reach out to people in your field for help and contacts. Networking was a lifesaver for me and opened me up to amazing products that I might not have found otherwise.

Conversation content on 21 July, 2023: [Jon]: [Image: a photography of a group of people standing in a room] Awesome advice! Lately I've been networking and it's gotten me some good stuff. Really can't beat what connections can do. Check this pic I got from the last networking event!

Posting dance clips or content related to dance can help. You could also collaborate with local influencers or dance communities. I could help you with making content or even managing your accounts if you want.
